KEYS.note: brass ring with a blue tag

captions.hl_20261028_1: The tote bangs against your knee as the tram crosses the windy waterfront.
captions.hl_20261101_4: The app pings the blue tag under a canvas bag by the door, exactly where you left them on Friday.
captions.hl_20261109_1: Everyone is in winter coats and the tram heater smells faintly of dust.
captions.hl_20261115_5: You ride two stops for the air, keys in your pocket, and walk back under a clear cold sky.
captions.hl_20261117_1: You drop the library card and keys into the canvas tote, find the missing tape measure at the bottom, and head out.

captions.hl_20261106_2: You photograph page after page of the paper notebook, squinting through the reading glasses at the smudged ones.
captions.hl_20261109_2: You work along the grain with the reading glasses pushed up and the radio off.
captions.hl_20261112_1: You go over the drawer fronts once more with the glasses on and find nothing left to fix.
captions.hl_20261115_4: The app locates the tortoiseshell reading glasses behind the jar of screws, on the shelf above the bench.
captions.hl_20261118_1: Fog on the windows; you scrub the timeline back to January and see a year of line 4 mornings stacked in rows.

captions.hl_20261030_6: You set out a bowl of wrapped candy and hang the wet umbrella by the door.
captions.hl_20261102_1: The tram windows fog at the edges and your umbrella drips into the well by the door.
captions.hl_20261103_3: The town slides past in halves, and you get off two stops early just to walk in it.
captions.hl_20261112_3: You take the tram across town with nothing to carry and enjoy the empty afternoon seats.
captions.hl_20261115_5: You ride two stops for the air, keys in your pocket, and walk back under a clear cold sky.

captions.hl_20261026_2: You clean old glue, measure the joint, and clamp the chair frame square.
captions.hl_20261028_2: You set the yellow tape measure against the cabinet door and mark hinge centers.
captions.hl_20261028_5: The app question 'where is the yellow tape measure?' points under the chair frame.
captions.hl_20261105_3: You ask the app where the yellow tape was last recorded and it answers: the bench by the window, under a rag.
captions.hl_20261111_3: You measure twice with the yellow tape, bend a small bracket, and fix it across the weak corner.

captions.hl_20261031_3: You re-glue wing joints, shorten a strap, and add a soft cloth cuff to the robot arm.
captions.hl_20261031_6: You sweep glue scraps and switch on the repaired desk lamp after the last knock.
captions.hl_20261104_2: A loose corner gets a careful bead of hot glue and a clamp, and the recording pauses while you hold it steady.
captions.hl_20261111_2: You dig out four short screws, run a bead of glue into the split, and clamp it while the kettle boils.
captions.hl_20261112_4: You browse hinges you do not need yet and buy only glue sticks and a box of small screws.

captions.hl_20261107_2: Tomas arranges the radios in a queue by size while you lay out the toolbox and the screw jar.
captions.hl_20261107_6: Three fixes out of five, one kettle kept for next week, and the hall swept before four.
captions.hl_20261111_3: You measure twice with the yellow tape, bend a small bracket, and fix it across the weak corner.
captions.hl_20261114_1: The mentor pins the winter notice to the board while you set out the toolbox for the final Saturday.
captions.hl_20261117_4: You test the power cord of a radio Tomas might want for Saturday, then start sanding the cabinet doors Ines left last week.

captions.hl_20261101_5: You wipe down the repaired desk lamp and put the paper notebook back where you can find it.
captions.hl_20261109_3: The repaired metal desk lamp passes its test again, and you set it aside for the cafe bench.
captions.hl_20261114_5: A visitor takes the repaired metal desk lamp for a dark hallway and promises to bring the kettle next year.
captions.hl_20261118_2: You star the clips worth keeping: the desk lamp coming back to life, Pip's first repair, Hollis's dresser sliding shut.
captions.hl_20261118_5: You ask where the paper notebook was last seen; the app points to the desk, and it's under the lamp, just off the edge.

captions.hl_20261028_6: You lean into the wind with the umbrella closed and the wallet zipped in the tote.
captions.hl_20261029_2: The bakery counter bags a rye loaf and two cinnamon buns for the weekend.
captions.hl_20261031_2: You buy a rye loaf and a small bag of buns, then tuck the wallet away.
captions.hl_20261109_1: Everyone is in winter coats and the tram heater smells faintly of dust.
captions.hl_20261110_5: You put the library card where it belongs and the wallet back in the coat pocket.
